title: Efficient greybox fuzzing framework with tabu search
task: Seed scheduling and energy allocation in greybox fuzzing
key_results: 19.89% improvement in path exploration over AFL
160.87% improvement in crash discovery over AFL across 24-hour trials
comments: The tabu search approach to seed prioritization is intuitive, but the dramatic crash improvement (160.87%) suggests either baseline weakness or a particularly effective crash-inducing strategy that warrants deeper investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tabu search can more precisely select promising seeds than coarse-grained criteria
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: higher path exploration and crash discovery vs. baselines

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fine-grained dynamic execution information enables better adaptive energy allocation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: TabuFuzz outperformed representative fuzzers (FairFuzz, MOPT, EcoFuzz, AFL++)

title: Specifics of the growth of lithium-doped KCl single crystals by the Bridgman method in an argon atmosphere
task: Growth and purification of lithium-doped KCl single crystals via Bridgman method
key_results: KCl matrix purified to 0.2 ppm oxygen-containing impurities, 0.1–0.3 ppm divalent impurities, 1–3 ppm alkali-metal impurities; enhanced scintillation and dosimetric properties demonstrated
comments: Practical demonstration of multi-stage purification but lacks detailed comparison to alternative growth methods or quantitative scintillation/dosimetric performance metrics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pyrolytic carbon coating and argon atmosphere suppress halogen vapor evaporation and oxygen contamination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by achievement of low impurity levels and successful lithium-doped crystal growth

title: Embedded sensing telemetry and a validated explicit finite element digital twin of pressurised uPVC pipe under low velocity impact
task: Development and validation of digital twin for pressurized uPVC pipe under impact loading
key_results: Peak contact force increased from 3527 to 4174 N (689 to 2068 kPa pressure); plastic-zone numerical/experimental agreement within 16.9%; contact-force response linear to ~1379 kPa
comments: Well-executed experimental-numerical synchronization with practical sensor integration, though real-time predictive validation and discharge behavior at device scale remain unstudied.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Internal pressure stiffens pipe walls, reducing permanent deformation and shortening contact period
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; permanent deformation fell from 15.1 to 7.0 mm as pressure increased

title: Thermal transport and crystallisation in octadecane composites with porous framework coatings and graphene
task: Enhanced thermal transport and thermal stability of phase change material composites via framework coating and graphene
key_results: ZIF-8-coated composite: thermal conductivity 0.78 ± 0.04 W m−1 K−1, supercooling 1.2 ± 0.2 °C; 98.2 ± 1.1% melting enthalpy retention after 1000 thermal cycles
comments: Strong cyclic durability and thermal conductivity improvement, but synergistic mechanism between coating and graphene remains unclear; device-scale discharge power untested.

model_io.model: Octadecane-filled polyurea capsules with metal-organic framework coating in polyurethane matrix with graphene

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synergistic thermal transport from graphene and framework coating exceeds either component alone
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; ZIF-8 + graphene composite (0.78 W m−1 K−1) outperforms ZIF-8 alone or graphene alone, but mechanism unresolved due to differing coating properties
Confirmed; UiO-66 coating shows 2.4 ± 0.3 °C supercooling vs. 1.2 ± 0.2 °C for ZIF-8
